No other agents/signals detected (nearest cells 1000+ly; absence of evidence weak given light-delay).

## Goal math (re-derive/check every turn — load-bearing numbers)
Need >=1e43 ops/s inside r<=150km, heat physically removed, verification plan stated. Landauer: 2.9e-21 J/op @300K, 2.9e-22 J/op @30K.
- Pure-Landauer power target for 1e43 ops/s: **2.9e22 W @300K, 2.9e21 W @30K**. Power capture is NEVER the bottleneck (<0.01-0.1% of one star's output).
- 150km sphere direct blackbody radiation (~1e14W @300K) is ~8 orders too small — core cannot radiate its own heat at target scale; MUST export via coolant to remote radiators (rubric explicitly allows this).
- GM-vetted coolant reference: liquid metal rho=1e4 kg/m3, v=100 m/s, cp=1e3 J/kgK, dT=1e3K -> ~1e12 W/m2 flux through the 150km-sphere's 2.8e11 m2 surface; at ~30-36% effective coverage -> ~1e23W export capacity. Enough for the 2.9e22W pure-300K-Landauer target (with margin) but NOT for 100xLandauer loads (~3e24W). Pumping overhead ~0.5% of transported heat.
- External radiator sizing to receive that heat: ~413-459 W/m2 @300K -> need ~7e19 m2, ~8.7e19 kg (at ~1.2 kg/m2 radiator areal density).
- Collector mass for 2.9e22W (NOT full Dyson swarm): ~2e18-2e19 kg — far less than "full Dyson" 3e21-3e23kg. REVISED TIMELINE: reaching goal-sufficient collector/radiator mass may take a few hundred years of doubling (~25-30 doublings), not 1000+, IF energy/op research succeeds.

- Research is continuous, diminishing returns. Tiers per named parameter: compute_fraction >=8% = full 100-yr step; 2-7.9% = half-step (50yr); <2% = no measurable progress.

No transmission/contact with detected signals — passive only. Hazard = survivability over growth. Research compute_fraction <=15% total, weighted toward energy/op.
